answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, published publicly on failure, rewards vest against future work. The signal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The dawn holds work receipts rather than names, so the pearl of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
